rules.name: Replace \DI\object() with \DI\create() in elgg-services.php
Replace Zend\Mail with Laminas\Mail
rules.llm_instructions:
Replace all `Zend\Mail` namespace references with `Laminas\Mail`. This applies to:
- `use` statements
- Type hints
- `instanceof` checks
- Class instantiation

Also update composer.json if it requires any `zendframework/*` packages — replace with `laminas/*` equivalents.

rules.name: Replace magic setters for protected entity attributes
rules.llm_instructions:
In Elgg 4.0, certain entity attributes can no longer be set via magic setter (`$entity->attr = value`):

- `$entity->type = 'object'` → not allowed (set at creation)
- `$entity->subtype = 'blog'` → `$entity->setSubtype('blog')`
- `$entity->enabled = 'yes'` → `$entity->enable()` / `$entity->disable()`
- `$user->admin = true` → `$user->makeAdmin()` / `$user->removeAdmin()`
- `$user->banned = true` → `$user->ban()` / `$user->unban()`

Search for `->type =`, `->subtype =`, `->enabled =`, `->admin =`, `->banned =` on entity objects.
rules.breaking_change: type, subtype, enabled, admin, banned no longer settable via magic setter

rules.name: Update response class usage
rules.llm_instructions:
Response classes were restructured:
- `OkResponse`, `ErrorResponse`, `RedirectResponse` no longer inherit from `OkResponse`
- All extend `Elgg\Http\Response` and implement `ResponseBuilder`
- `elgg_error_response()` default HTTP code changed from 200 to 400

If your plugin creates response objects directly or checks `instanceof OkResponse`, update accordingly.
rules.breaking_change: Response class hierarchy changed, elgg_error_response default code is 400
